title: Denominator clearing for a finite type domain
statement: ∃ D' : Derivation ℤ B B, D' f ≠ 0

proof.text: This is the corresponding strictly smaller structural step in the proof of Lemma 07PH; the complete algebraic argument is recorded in the declaration docstring.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_domain_derivation_of_fraction_derivation
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CharP B p]
    (M : Type v) [Field M] [Algebra B M] [IsFractionRing B M]
    (R₀ : Type w) [CommRing R₀] [IsNoetherianRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀) R₀]
    [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra.FiniteType R₀ B]
    (f : B) (D : Derivation ℤ M M) (hD : D (algebraMap B M f) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D' : Derivation ℤ B B, D' f ≠ 0
